email_subject: Application - Founding Creator and Social Media Associate
email_body:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate role. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in content creation, social media integration, and video-friendly storytelling, I'm excited about the opportunity to capture LINEAL's journey and make people want to follow it.

At Episto, I've honed my skills in content strategy and production, writing keyword-targeted blogs and building WordPress sites. On my own project, mirook.com, I've designed and built a multi-page site, integrated social media, and implemented structured data to boost visibility—showing my ability to own a project from concept to execution.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and am available for onsite events and travel. I'm eager to bring my creator mindset, technical skills, and passion for storytelling to LINEAL, working courtside and backstage to turn athletes and events into compelling stories.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear LINEAL Team,

I'm thrilled to apply for the Founding Creator and Social Media Associate position. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation and a passion for storytelling, I'm drawn to LINEAL's mission to capture the raw, behind-the-scenes moments of professional sports. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, just outside Antwerp, and ready to be where the story happens—courtside, backstage, and on the road.

In my current role at Episto, I've developed a strong foundation in content creation and digital strategy. I write keyword-targeted blog content, manage on-page SEO, and build and maintain WordPress sites—skills that translate directly to planning and publishing a continuous flow of engaging content. I'm comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics and SEMrush to measure performance and refine strategies.

My independent project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to own the entire content journey. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, integrated social media feeds, and implemented structured data to improve search visibility. This project demonstrates my creator mindset—from initial concept to final upload—and my ability to work independently.

I'm eager to bring my technical skills and creative energy to LINEAL. I'm available for onsite meetings, athlete shoots, and events, and I'm excited about the opportunity to develop recurring formats, from fight-night highlights to behind-the-scenes stories. I'm a quick learner, passionate about sports, and ready to contribute to building LINEAL's community from the ground up.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of working together.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
